snippet.title: pig  butchery scam expose
snippet.description:
The Pig Butchering Scam is one of the fastest-growing online fraud schemes in the world. Known as “Sha Zhu Pan”, this sophisticated scam targets victims through social media, dating apps, and messaging platforms—slowly building trust before stealing huge amounts of money through fake cryptocurrency investments.

In this video, we uncover how the pig butchering scam works, the psychology scammers use to manipulate victims, and the shocking global networks behind this multi-billion dollar fraud industry. Victims are often groomed for weeks or months before being convinced to invest in fake trading platforms that appear legitimate but are completely controlled by scammers.

🔎 What You’ll Learn in This Video:
• What the Pig Butchering Scam really is
• How scammers build emotional relationships with victims
• Why cryptocurrency is often used in these scams
• Warning signs that you are being targeted
• Real stories of people who lost their savings
• How to protect yourself and your family from online fraud

Scammers carefully “fatten” their victims with fake profits and trust before the final stage—where they convince them to invest larger sums of money. Once the victim sends the funds, the scammers disappear, leaving devastating financial losses.

⚠️ As online scams become more sophisticated, awareness is the first line of defense. By understanding how these fraud networks operate, you can avoid becoming their next target.

snippet.title: Stiching Robot | AI Weekly
snippet.description:
Recent advancements in humanoid robotics demonstrate a shift from experimental prototypes to functional machines capable of mastering complex human skills. A standout achievement from Tar Robotics involves a robot performing delicate hand embroidery, proving that machines can now handle soft, unpredictable materials that once required human precision. Meanwhile, Figure AI has improved everyday interaction with its third-generation assistant, while commercial demand is surging as seen by the rapid sell-out of autonomous robot dogs. In the industrial sector, CATL has successfully integrated humanoids into battery production lines to perform high-stakes safety tasks at scale. Collectively, these developments represent a global acceleration in robotics, where embodied intelligence is transitioning from laboratory settings into homes and factories. Looking forward, the upcoming public debut of Boston Dynamics' Atlas at CES 2026 signals a future where robots are central to global manufacturing strategies.
